column3: Kuroneko Route · The Frying Pan and the Fish
I couldn't talk to Kuroneko in the morning because of that idiot.
I'll try heading to the first years' classrooms to meet her.
U-Um... Oh right, last night when I called you, you texted me saying you're in the middle of something. What were you doing?
...I was frying fish on the frying pan.
I was thinking if it was something like that.
Still cold as ever, I see...
Why don't we have lunch together?
